name: Malawi (2010–2012)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, black and green with a full white sun with radiating rays in the centre.
history: Adopted on 29 July 2010 at the proposal of the Democratic Progressive Party government of President Bingu wa Mutharika, replacing the rising sun of the 1964 flag with a full white sun to symbolise the country's development; it was widely known as 'Bingu's flag'. On 28 May 2012, under President Joyce Banda, Parliament voted to restore the independence flag.
